2608.12262.title: Diagram-MMU: A Multi-Modal Benchmark for Scientific Diagrams
2608.12262.paper_summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been growing the capability for scientific writing and collaboration. For example, OpenAI Prism is a free workspace for scientific writing and collaboration. One important feature in Prism is turning scientific diagrams directly into LaTeX TikZ code. In this paper, we build a benchmark, Diagram-MMU, a multi-modal benchmark designed to assess MLLMs' ability for scientific diagram parsing and understanding. Diagram-MMU features 3.7k curated diagrams and 18.3k human-validated questions across six domains. It evaluates MLLMs on three tasks common in vibe writing workspaces: diagram-to-code parsing, diagram-to-code editing, and diagram question answering, alongside agentic settings per task. The evaluation of 12 MLLMs reveals that diagram-to-code tasks are more challenging than diagram question answering: models can reason well over diagrams but struggle to parse and edit them, underscoring the need for methods to enhance MLLMs' capability in diagram-to-code generation. Under agentic settings, most models improve parsing and editing performance but degrade on question answering, while Claude-4.6 Opus consistently improves across all three tasks. Project Page: https://vi-ocean.github.io/projects/diagram-mmu.
2608.12262.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在科學寫作和協作方面的能力不斷增強。<lb/>例如，OpenAI Prism 是一個免費的科學寫作和協作工作空間。<lb/>Prism 中的一個重要功能是將科學圖表直接轉換為 LaTeX TikZ 代碼。<lb/>在本文中，我們建立了一個基準，Diagram-MMU，這是一個旨在評估 MLLMs 在科學圖表解析和理解能力的多模態基準。<lb/>Diagram-MMU 包含 3.7k 精選圖表和 18.3k 經人類驗證的問題，涵蓋六個領域。<lb/>它在三個在寫作工作空間中常見的任務上評估 MLLMs：圖表到代碼解析、圖表到代碼編輯和圖表問題回答，以及每個任務的代理設置。<lb/>對 12 個 MLLMs 的評估顯示，圖表到代碼任務比圖表問題回答更具挑戰性：模型能夠很好地推理圖表，但在解析和編輯方面卻面臨困難，這突顯了增強 MLLMs 在圖表到代碼生成能力方面方法的必要性。<lb/>在代理設置下，大多數模型在解析和編輯性能上有所改善，但在問題回答上卻下降，而 Claude-4.6 Opus 在所有三個任務上始終有所提升。<lb/>項目頁面：https://vi-ocean.github.io/projects/diagram-mmu。
